warn condition-not-carried: the template template.yaml deploys Uploads under the condition InEu, which is not one template parameter allowing only true and false compared with true, so the condition is not carried and the resource is drafted as deployed whatever the condition decides: write active on its instance by hand, switching off with it every instance whose connection reaches it, as a switched-off target halts the build
warn value-not-carried: the template template.yaml writes Fn::If on the condition InEu at /Resources/Uploads/Properties/BucketName, which the value the template parameter Region is given makes true, so the draft carries its branch at /Resources/Uploads/Properties/BucketName/Fn::If/1 and not the one at /Resources/Uploads/Properties/BucketName/Fn::If/2: where the stack deploys with a value of Region that makes InEu false, write that branch by hand
info resource-folded: UploadsPolicy (AWS::S3::BucketPolicy) is folded into the instance of Uploads, written at infra.overrides.policy
